# Shangeeth Sivan

Personal site of Shangeeth Sivan, a staff software engineer in Chennai. He builds Android and Kotlin systems, leads community work, and writes about performance, JIT, and teaching with AI.

Search and answer engines may use these pages. Model-training crawlers are asked not to, via Content Signals in robots.txt.
